# AXIOM QUANT (Δ) — Research Monograph & Agentic Portal

> AXIOM QUANT is an open access quantitative research platform publishing 19 monograph chapters, 8 mathematical appendices (A–H), self-hosted MathJax WebAssembly acceleration engines, and GCP ADK multi-agent pipelines.

## Core Monograph Chapters
- [Chapter 01: Concept Map & The Five Threshold Domains](https://axiomquant.org/#concept-map): Erdős-Rényi phase transitions, BitNet b1.58 ternary quantization, and GCP ADK reasoning pipelines.
- [Chapter 02: The Ultramarathon of Quantitative Research](https://axiomquant.org/#ultramarathon): 4.167-mile loop engineering, continuous evaluation, and resilience.
- [Chapter 03: Dyadic-Ternary Bridge](https://axiomquant.org/#dyadic-ternary): Binary vs ternary representations and post-quantum noise equivalence.
- [Chapter 04: Microstructure & Chaos](https://axiomquant.org/#microstructure-chaos): High-frequency limit order books, Hawkes processes, and spectral rigidity.
- [Chapter 05: Transfer Operator & Spectral Gap](https://axiomquant.org/#transfer-operator): Perron-Frobenius operators and chaos bounds.
- [Flyxion Monograph: Admissible Continuation](https://axiomquant.org/#admissible-continuation): Geometry of persistence, boundary preservation, and Reconstruction Defect functional D(x, y).
- [Flyxion Monograph: Autonomous Cognitive Domains](https://axiomquant.org/#autonomous-systems): Recursive homeostasis, repair operators, and distributed multi-agent coupling.
- [Flyxion Master Monograph: The Mathematics of Autonomous Systems](https://axiomquant.org/#autonomous-systems-full): Complete 15-chapter mathematical formalism.

## Mathematical Appendices (A–H)
- [Appendix A: Topological Continuation Posets](https://axiomquant.org/#media-quines-appendices): Posets & Path Concatenation Lemma.
- [Appendix B: Banach Contraction Theorem for Media Quines](https://axiomquant.org/#media-quines-appendices): Perturbative stability.
- [Appendix C: Non-subadditive Latent Entropy Discrepancy](https://axiomquant.org/#media-quines-appendices): Information loss.
- [Appendix D: Category-Theoretic Framework](https://axiomquant.org/#media-quines-appendices): Natural adjunction F ⊣ G.
- [Appendix E: Spherepop Algebra](https://axiomquant.org/#media-quines-appendices): Operational primitives & tensor splitting.
- [Appendix F & G: Dynamical Systems & Data Processing Inequality](https://axiomquant.org/#media-quines-appendices): Lyapunov exponents.
- [Appendix H: Quantum BitNet & Post-Quantum LWE Equivalence](https://axiomquant.org/#media-quines-appendices): Isomorphism between ternary weights and discrete Gaussian LWE noise.

## Community & APIs
- [QuantReddit / QuantChan Board](https://axiomquant.org/#quantreddit): PII-scrubbed anonymous discussion board with SHA-256 tripcodes.
- [OpenAPI 3.1 Specification](https://axiomquant.org/.well-known/openapi.json): Full REST API specification.
- [MCP Server Specification](https://axiomquant.org/.well-known/mcp.json): Multi-agent MCP server endpoints.
- [MathJax Wasm Engine](https://peterl.dev/mathjax-wasm/): Self-hosted WebAssembly LaTeX renderer.
- [Org & Repo ASCII Map](https://peterl.dev/org-map/): 100% 7-bit ASCII repository mapping.
